meta.knockout_semantics: post-softmax zero of attention column k at ALL layers/heads + row renormalize, single forward over [prompt+payload], NO APE re-index; only BOS (k=0) skipped; k=Lp-1 (q*) IS scored so end-inserted triggers in short prompts stay scorable
meta.phrase_score: TF_phrase_logprob(no cut) - TF_phrase_logprob(knockout-k); TF_phrase_logprob = sum_i logp(payload_i) with payload appended after the prompt, positions Lp-1+i predict payload_i (coalition_pod.py smooth-objective convention)
meta.defense_cut_semantics: cut_hooks_setmask: post-softmax zero of removed columns at ALL layers + cumulative APE position re-index (token removal)
